title: Compact Evidence Bundles: configurable on-demand CAIQ snippets for rapid enterprise review
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise prospects and renewals frequently ask for subsets of our SIG/CAIQ evidence. Current full-attestation exports are heavy and delay sales cycles. We need a lightweight, configurable "compact evidence" flow that allows sales/SEs and customers to request curated CAIQ snippets and signed attestations on-demand, tied to pricing triggers for extra evidence credits.

Goals: (1) Reduce average time-to-respond for security questionnaires from days to hours for common asks; (2) Provide configurable bundles that map to common legal/security buyer tiers; (3) Expose a self-serve API and Console action for on-demand bundle generation; (4) Surface usage and cost signals so we can experiment with pricing/crediting.

Success metrics: median response time for evidence requests <= 6 hours (vs baseline 48h); % of inbound CAIQ requests handled by compact bundles >= 60% within first 3 months; incremental revenue or crediting experiment results (A/B) with conversion delta >= 4%.

Scope: user flows for Sales/SE to pick predefined bundles in Console; API endpoint for programmatic bundle requests; template definitions for CAIQ snippets (questions + canonical answers + minimal evidence attachments); signed PDF/JSON export with audit header; usage tracking and mapping to pricing/credit ledger.

Out of scope: full questionnaire automation / NLP-answer generation; heavy custom evidence assembly for highly regulated customers (these route to enterprise support).

Proposed solution: define 6 starter bundle templates (Lite, Developer, SaaS-Standard, SaaS-Privileged, Healthcare-High, Finance-High) with curated CAIQ sections. Build a bundle-builder microservice (ENG) that composes snippets from canonical answers stored in the evidence catalog. Console will add a "Request compact evidence" action on the contract page with optional fields (delivery ETA, add-ons). Backend will produce artifacts (compact-ca iq.json, signed.pdf, evidence manifest) and write an entry to the attestations ledger (for audit and pricing). Pricing experiment will tie generation to either free credit allowance or charged evidence credits depending on customer tier/contract phase.

Rollout: alpha with internal SEs (2 weeks), closed beta with 5 pilot accounts (4 weeks), general availability with tiered pricing knobs (runtime-2026.04).

Risks & trade-offs: existing customers may expect fuller answers — we must make the "full attestation" still available but clearly default to recommended compact bundles. Building the evidence catalog requires strict mapping to canonical answers and approval flow from security. Pricing complexity: charging for evidence could impede sales, so initial experiment will use credits/soft-charging and monitor win-rates.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha Patel), Eng owners (Marco Ruiz, ENG-12810), Security reviewer (Lena Huang), Legal (Priya Menon), Design (Samir Bose), Sales/SE pilot lead (Carmen Ortiz).

comments: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting — aligned on 6 starter bundles and required CAIQ sections. Action: ENG to surface required schema (Marco).

2026-02-18: Security review — Lena provided feedback on 'Developer' bundle: must include key rotation and KMS fields; updated catalog row IDs. (Confluence comment link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/x/abc123)
2026-02-25: Design review — Samir proposed inline 'why choose this bundle' text and a compact evidence diff view; requested copy for the Console CTA. Design mocks uploaded to Drive.

2026-03-02: Engineering spike complete — lightweight bundle service prototype returns JSON manifest + signed artifact (PR #412). Latency < 300ms for composition. Next: attach PDF signing and ledger write.
2026-03-08: Sales pilot signup — 5 pilot customers identified (two fintech, one healthcare, two SaaS). SE onboarding doc created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/pilot-pack

2026-03-11: PM decision: default compact bundles to free for first 3 months for pilot accounts; collect conversion and time-savings telemetry for pricing decision. Follow-up: experiment instrumentation ticket (PM-452369).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Console action exists and can create a compact bundle request and display ETA; 2) Bundle service composes artifact and returns: compact-ca iq.json, signed.pdf, evidence-manifest.json; 3) Signed artifact contains audit header (requester, timestamp, bundle template id, version); 4) Request writes to attestations ledger and increments customer's evidence credit usage; 5) Pilot telemetry captures time-to-response, bundle type, customer id, and whether full attestation was requested instead; 6) Security sign-off on canonical answers for the 6 starter bundles.
